# Oracle cell — preactjs/preact, zone `.`, 2026-09-19

Repo: https://github.com/preactjs/preact, shallow clone at `~/.hobbes/bench/js-cells/repos/preactjs__preact`, commit `8101ff821690` (fixed for this cell). Picked as the ESM shape: JavaScript with JSDoc types and JSX, typed by its own `src/index.d.ts`, with a `jsconfig.json` that maps `preact` onto the repo. Pre-registered in `oracle-grading.md` §10.22 before any ingest (P134–P142). Hobbes 0.2.54-beta; lane B contained (`HOBBES_SCIP=1`); the ingest reports a dirty tree only because `hobbes ingest` appends `.hobbes/` to the clone's `.gitignore` (ADR-012). pnpm's lockfile: nothing provisioned (C-23). The ingest prints its `jsconfig.json` as not read, 241 files under the default options (C-166); on the key alone 120 of 22,804 sites resolve differently under it, stated here and never in the numbers (P142). Oracle = the TS oracle with `--no-tsconfig` (ADR-140 step 3): the program the ingest generates for files no `tsconfig.json` claims (`allowJs`, ESNext, Bundler), over a copy of the clone without `demo/`, `test/ts/` and `compat/test/ts/` — the three `tsconfig.json` zones, which `--no-tsconfig` refuses — so the program is exactly the ingest's root zone; Hobbes edges in those zones read `silent`/`not-loaded`, run in the image with no network; tsc 5.9.3, the harness's.

Command: `~/.hobbes/bench/js-cells/grade.sh preact <clone> <oracle tree>` (ingest, `oracle export --lang ts`, the oracle, `oracle grade --poison`), then `regrade.sh h34` after H-34/H-35's fix. Outputs in `~/.hobbes/bench/js-cells/cells/preact/` and `regrade/h34/preact/`.

## Triage

**The first pass read 1,201 confirmed and 1,223 contradicted, every one the oracle's**: 1,220 were H-34 (an in-repo `.d.ts` declaration keyed external with an absolute path, where Hobbes' edge names the same line of the same file) and 3 were H-35 (a JSDoc `@type` on `didSnapshotChange` keyed as the annotation's line). Both fixed (`d715849`); the numbers below are the regrade, with no re-ingest. About 6,300 of the 6,579 misses sit in test files: in-body closures (2,028), calls through interface members its `.d.ts` declares (1,792), hook setters in locals (1,557) and constructions (570, C-168).
